title: Feels cheap, stains easily, but hasn't broken yet.
text:
Feels cheap, stains easily, but hasn't broken yet.. The glass this is made from is very thin and feels fragile. I'm honestly surprised I haven't cracked or chipped it in the year I've been using it. It also stains easily, as it has blackened especially so in the spout.
The metal is thin, but doesn't feel as cheap. I'm still able to make my tea without it spilling or becoming too hot, so I guess I'll continue to use until it's no longer functional.
